source.notes: Top-level request parameters listed on the provider's chat API reference (accessed 2026-10-17). Nested shapes are not modelled. Only a quick-start page found; params are those used in the examples, not a reference list. Example curl authenticates with an "api-key" header (gateway may use Bearer). Assistant messages carry reasoning_content in thinking mode and docs recommend sending it back in multi-turn tool calls. Thinking on/off parameter is on a separate Deep Thinking guide (not reviewed); third-party guides use extra_b
